title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.7 (Peaked November 08, 2026 at 04:18 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.9 (Peaked November 07, 2026 at 18:42 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 728 km/s (Intense)
🧲 Bz: +5.9 nT (Northward)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: G1 Minor Storm (Kp 5.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 5

Things are stirring down here. The solar wind picked up the pace. 🌐🌫🌌😯

Solar imagery shows several bright active regions, a visible sunspot group, and a broad dark coronal-hole-like region across the disk.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
